query: I just tried the new matcha latte at the café around the corner earlier today, it had just the right amount of honey and not too bitter at all, I’m already thinking about going back tomorrow to get another one. Oh and my cat figured out how to open the kitchen cabinet last night, I woke up to a whole bag of kibble spilled all over the floor, spent half an hour cleaning that up, she’s way too clever for her own good. Also, I started that new gardening project on my balcony over the weekend, the tomato seeds I planted already have little sprouts coming up, I’m so excited to see if they actually produce fruit this summer. Anyway, I’m currently abroad and my roaming is turned off, I already exceeded my data usage limit and I have data mode turned off right now, but my mobile data still seems to be running in the background and using up my allowance, I’m not sure why that’s happening.
